The '''''Raider I''-class corvette''' was the first sub-class of the [[Raider-class corvette/Legends|''Raider''-class]] line of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was succeeded by the [[Raider II-class corvette/Legends|''Raider II''-class corvette]].
